candidates.summary: An opener left unclosed in a blockquote or list item keeps its gno-* depth level until the end of the page, past its container, so four of them refuse every gno-* block rendered after them
candidates.failure_scenario: A realm renders a user comment through sanitize.BlockRich, then its own <gno-columns> grid, a > [!WARNING] alert and a <gno-details summary="Admin"> block. The comment is four lines of `> <gno-details>` (or `- <gno-details>`), which BlockRich passes unescaped. Each opener Pushes; the blockquote ends without a close, nothing Pops until Transform at EOF, so depth stays at 4. The realm's grid is refused and falls to a raw HTML block that swallows its A|||B body, the alert renders as a plain quote reading `[!WARNING]`, and the realm's own details renders as a comment with its body unfolded. A realm author's own unclosed openers in list items do the same. This contradicts the SANITIZE.md BlockRich row ("the realm's own block and what follows it stay out of reach") and the ADR sanitizer bullet; TestDetailsDepthBalanced only reads the depth after the EOF pop, so it stays green. An unclosed `> <gno-columns>` holds nothing in the same position. ext_details.go is absent at the merge base 02606904e.
